text:
Christopher Columbus.

It is truly inspiring to see the company’s commitment to 'exploration' by repackaging the same planet with a new name and increasing the price of existence. One must admire the audacity and sheer creativity involved in convincing the indigenous population that what they really need is essentially the same world they already inhabit, but with a sleek adjective added to its name: "The New World." After all, why settle for the old, familiar geography when you can have the exciting, uncharted *discovery* of a landmass that was already there, just waiting for someone to claim it and charge admission for the privilege of being found?
